page.overview:
Who is By Bluss?

By Bluss was a male Leyakian who served as a senator in the Separatist Senate during the Clone Wars.

By Bluss was a politician who, along with the Head of State of the Confederacy of Independent Systems Count Dooku, created the Separatist Senate. Bluss served in the legislative body as a senator and as a member of the Senate's Peace Faction. During the Clone Wars, Bluss was present in the Senate chamber where Senator Mina Bonteri of Onderon made a plea with other senators that peace talks should be proposed with the Senate of the Galactic Republic to end the war peacefully. Bluss supported Mina by voting "aye", as she proposed the Confederacy to attempt to establish peace talks with the Republic, while other senators like Voe Atell and Punn Rimbaud voted "nay" to continue the war.

By Bluss first appeared in "Heroes on Both Sides," The senator was first identified by name in the accompanying StarWars.com Episode Guide, which released on the same day. Bluss did not appear in the final product. at the gala for Dooku's Raxian Humanitarian Award.
